basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 16E at The Infinity where luxury, location, and breathtaking views converge in the heart of San Francisco. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit offers large picture windows in every room showcasing views of the Water and Bay Bridge. The open-concept living space features hardwood floors, custom window treatments, and a chefs kitchen with premium Bosch and Thermador appliances, granite countertops, and Studio Becker cabinetry. The primary suite includes a generous walk-in closet and spa-like bath. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including 24-hour concierge, a 75-foot lap pool, fitness center, sauna, theater, club lounge, and business center. Located in the vibrant South Beach/Rincon Hill neighborhood, you're just steps from the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, and premier dining, shopping, and transit. Urban sophistication and resort-style living await.
